title: Nifty Reversal or Just a Relief Rally?
author: Former_Lengthiness15
selftext:
Nifty is bouncing today after yesterday’s sharp sell-off, but the bigger picture is still complicated.

Crude is still elevated above $100, global bond yields remain high, the rupee is under pressure, and the US Fed decision is due later today. Yesterday, Nifty closed at 23,118.60 after falling 1.19%, while early indications today point to a rebound.

So the real question isn't simply:

“Is Nifty going up today?”

comments.author: Foreign-Safe-8161
comments.body: *Trying to trade intraday or short-term swings based on a cocktail of crude prices, bond yields, and Fed decisions is a fast track to noise trading. If your strategy's survival depends on guessing whether a macro headline triggers a 'reversal' or a 'relief rally', you aren't running a quant system—you're just playing discretionary roulette with extra steps. Build a pipeline that filters out the macro noise and tests structural execution edges instead.*
